name: curlshot
description: Website screenshots in Claude Code through the hosted CurlShot MCP server: render any public URL as an image Claude can see, a PDF, or a scrolling video, with full-page capture, device presets, dark mode and single-element capture by CSS selector. Needs a CurlShot API key in CURLSHOT_API_KEY (free plan: 100 screenshots a month, no card).
